TABLE.NAME: tool_pluginvisibility_hidden
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores hidden plugins (activities, resources, blocks) for categories

FIELD.NAME: categoryid
FIELD.COMMENT: The category ID where this setting applies

FIELD.NAME: applytosubcategories
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to apply this setting to subcategories (0=no, 1=yes)

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the record was created

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp when the record was last modified

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: User ID who last modified this record

INDEX.NAME: categoryid_idx
INDEX.COMMENT: Index on categoryid for quick lookups

INDEX.NAME: applytosubcategories_idx
INDEX.COMMENT: Index on applytosubcategories for recursion queries

INDEX.NAME: category_plugin_idx
INDEX.COMMENT: Unique index to prevent duplicate entries for the same category and plugin
